About me

Faraj Alrmah · Frontend developer

I studied software engineering at the College of Electronic Technology in Tripoli, and somewhere between algorithms and database classes I realised the part I loved most was the part people actually see.

Today I build interfaces with React, Next.js, TypeScript and Tailwind. I care about the small things — how a button feels when you press it, how fast a page shows up on a slow connection, and whether the layout still holds together on a cheap phone.

  • 2024 — now

    Frontend developer

    Company websites, web apps and dashboards for clients, mostly in React and Next.js.

  • Projects

    Ta'allam learning platform & college digital library

    Designed and built both, from the first wireframe to the PHP back end.

  • Education

    College of Electronic Technology, Tripoli

    Software development, web systems, algorithms and databases.
